description: arXiv:2608.14795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An AI that can only give advice seems safe: the human is always free to ignore it. That is the premise of the boxing tradition in AI safety, and its long-suspected weak point is that the human who reads the answers is part of the system. We make the fraction $\varepsilon_t$ of behavior that follows the advice a state of a Markov decision process,...
author: Adam M. Oberman
